svg.title: Known-best packing of 261 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=261 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the near-axis squares straightened and slid into exact contact, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete e70342d rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records, and equal there to the source's own corners Witness/v2; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=261 regularized: side ~ 16.67877988 (certified upper bound)
